```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
data(BostonHousing2)
```


```{r}
outliers <- function(Var,probs = c(0.25, 0.75)) {
 #Step 1: Find Q1, Q3, and the IQR
quarts <- quantile(BostonHousing2[[Var]], probs = probs)
iqr <- quarts[2] - quarts[1]

# Step 2: Find the bounds
ub <- quarts[2] + 1.5 * iqr
lb <- quarts[1] - 1.5 * iqr

# Step 3: Show the outliers
inds <- which(BostonHousing2[[Var]] < lb | BostonHousing2[[Var]] > ub)
BostonHousing2 |> slice(inds) |>  head(3)
 return() 
}
outliers ("medv", c(0.3,0.8))
```



```{r}
outlier <- BostonHousing2 |> select(medv, crim, zn, indus) |>
map(quantile)

print(outlier)
```

```{r}
box <- function(var) {
 ggplot(data= BostonHousing2, aes(x = var))+
  geom_boxplot()
  }

box(BostonHousing2$medv)
```

```{r}
printer <- function(var){
  arrange(BostonHousing2, desc(var))
}

printer(BostonHousing2$crim)
```
